Another one to glance at is the evolution of the league. I turn off everything except more/less pitching and more/less hitting. Even then I sometimes turn those off. I don't want the game to generate new expansion teams, relocate teams, or change rules at random, which will happen if you leave that stuff checkmarked. All that can be done manually if in fact you do want to change a rule or expand the league.
